south-pacific-1998.notes: Source 1: our only copy of the series home page dates from 2001 and is a links page for the 2000 regional (Regional Contest 2000 report, World Finals in Vancouver, plus history, rules and Australian/New Zealand results pages on elena.aut.ac.nz, none of which are in our copy). It would fit south-pacific-2000 as a web source; for 1998 an earlier snapshot (1998-1999) would be needed, if one exists. The linked History page might list 1998 results.

sources.evidence: Our copy is a single page, the 'ACM South Pacific Home Page' (Regional Home Page) as it stood in 2001, whose only edition-specific links are 'Regional Contest 2000 report' and 'World Finals in Vancouver'; nothing on it is about the 1998 contest.

south-pacific-2014.notes: The page gives only the event span 26-28 September 2014, no contest day. It links to a 2014 Regional scoreboard on public.webdev.aut.ac.nz/ACM/Scoreboards/2014/Regional, a candidate source if not already catalogued. The page names the region director; left out of the description.

sources.evidence: Page titled '2014 South Pacific Region Finals' announcing the ACM South Pacific Region Finals 2014, Sydney, 26-28 September, at the K17 Building, UNSW Australia.

south-pacific-2017.notes: Twelve Baekjoon problem pages (Wayback, 2020) for problems A to L, titles matching the catalogue; figures of problems A, B, C and J are external images not held in our copy.
